# PathPort — Technical Specifications & AI Engine Knowledge Base

Domain: https://getpathport.com
App: https://app.getpathport.com
Publisher: Veritas Technology Solutions, LLC (https://veritastech.io)
Contact: hello@getpathport.com | privacy@getpathport.com | legal@getpathport.com

## Product Invariant & Universal Positioning
PathPort is the universal, individual-owned credential tracker, encrypted document vault, verifiable portfolio (`MyPortfolio`), and career intelligence workspace (`MyPath`) built for everyone across every industry. Own your journey. Shape what’s next.
- **Universal Across Every Industry**: Whether you work in healthcare (RN, APRN, Paramedic, Physician), technology & project management (PMI PMP, AWS, CISSP), aviation, education, skilled trades, or research—or simply want to track personal identity documents—if you hold a credential, you can track it in PathPort.
- **Individual Sovereignty**: The individual owns the canonical profile, credentials held, continuing education history, personal identity documents, degrees, work experiences, structured case studies, projects, publications, and consent grants.
- **Personal Identity Documents Tracker ($0 Free Forever)**: Anyone can track everyday personal identity documents—such as a Driver's License, REAL ID, Passport, Global Entry / TSA PreCheck card, or Vehicle Registration—completely free so they never forget a renewal.
- **PathPort Workplace (Launching 2027)**: Built for any workforce that needs employees to hold and maintain credentials without sending countless emails. Organizations log in, select required credentials, and send requests to employees—who create a free PathPort profile, upload required docs, and share them with zero lost emails. Intelligence in the system keeps everyone compliant, and organizations can assign CEUs directly to training attendees.
- **PathPort Certify (Launching 2027)**: Complete end-to-end credential lifecycle management for organizations, certifying boards, and associations. Candidates can apply for a credential, submit documents, track application payments, sync exam results from official test platforms (or PathPort testing partners), receive digital badges through any badge provider, and manage ongoing recertifications directly inside PathPort.

## Multi-Source Ingestion & Smart-Suggested CE Attribution
1. **60-Second Multi-Source Onboarding**:
   - **PDF & Image Vault Upload**: Drag and drop licenses, certificates, wallet cards, and transcripts with SHA-256 cryptographic hashing.
   - **Email-to-Vault (`@in.getpathport.com`)**: Forward course completion emails directly to a personal `@in.getpathport.com` address for automatic extraction into the staging tray.
   - **Badge & Registry Sync**: Import digital badges from Credly, Accredible (`credential.net`), Badgr / Canvas Credentials, Coursera, and Open Badges 2.0/3.0.
   - **Scholarly & Technical Imports**: Sync publications and repositories via ORCID, PubMed, CrossRef/DOI, Google Scholar, BibTeX, GitHub, and Open Science Framework (OSF).
2. **Human-in-the-Loop Smart-Suggested CE Attribution**:
   - When continuing education (CE/CEU/CME/PDU) certificates are uploaded or emailed, PathPort parses the hours and issuer and **smart-suggests** matching requirement buckets.
   - Users review and confirm how hours apply—including applying a single qualifying course across multiple state or board credentials and automatically rolling surplus hours into general or elective requirement buckets.

## Four-Tier Provenance Model
PathPort never inflates verification claims. Every credential and artifact carries one of four explicit provenance tiers:
1. `Issuer-Verified`: Confirmed directly via an official licensing registry or issued natively through **PathPort Certify**.
2. `Provider-Reported`: Ingested directly from an accredited provider via `@in.getpathport.com` or verified digital badge assertion.
3. `Document-Supported`: Backed by a primary-source PDF or image certificate stored in the user's encrypted vault with a tamper-evident **SHA-256** hash.
4. `Self-Reported`: Claimed by the professional with structured metadata while primary documentation is pending.

## Core Product Surfaces
- **MyPortfolio (Tailored, Verifiable Sharing)**: Create unlimited role-specific portfolio views (`Public`, `Unlisted`, `Private`) with granular document download controls (`Downloadable`, `Preview-Only`, `Hidden Metadata-Only`) and immutable submission snapshots.
- **MyPath & PathAI (Career Intelligence & Interview Studio)**:
  - Evaluates the whole professional trajectory across 6 pillars (*Earn, Learn, Build, Demonstrate, Experience, Reflect*).
  - **What-If Role Audit**: Audits readiness against target roles, specialties, or states using public USDOL/ETA CareerOneStop licensing directories and Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) wage benchmarks.
  - **Application & Interview Studio (`MyInterview`)**: Generates evidence-backed cover letters, interview stories, and interactive voice/audio mock interview coaching grounded in verified career records.

## System Architecture, Sub-Processors & Security
- **Authentication**: Clerk (MFA, OAuth/SSO, session security, organization roles).
- **Database & Vault Storage**: Supabase PostgreSQL with mandatory Row-Level Security (RLS), AES-256 encryption at rest, TLS 1.3 in transit, user-isolated storage (`artifacts/{userId}/`), and SHA-256 file integrity hashing.
- **Edge & Email Ingress**: Cloudflare Pages, Workers, and `@in.getpathport.com` Email Routing.
- **Billing & Mobile Entitlements**: Stripe, RevenueCat, Apple App Store (StoreKit / IAP), and Google Play Billing.
- **Privacy Invariants**: Zero data selling to brokers, recruiters, or advertisers; zero training of public or third-party foundation AI models on private user documents; full self-service export and account deletion on Web, iOS, and Android.

## Pricing & Free Trial Policy
- **Personal Identity Documents Tracker ($0 • Free Forever)**: Track everyday identity documents (Driver's License, REAL ID, Passport, Global Entry / TSA PreCheck, Vehicle Registration) with proactive expiration reminders, plus respond to employer credential share requests via PathPort Workplace for free.
- **PathPort Essentials ($7.99/mo billed annually at $95.88/yr, or $9.99/mo billed monthly)**: Track up to 2 active professional credentials plus personal IDs, multi-category CE renewal logs, smart-suggested bucket attribution, 5 GB SHA-256 encrypted vault, and 1 public/unlisted MyPortfolio link.
- **PathPort Pro ($14.99/mo billed annually at $179.88/yr, or $19.99/mo billed monthly)**: Unlimited credentials, licenses, certifications, and personal IDs, `@in.getpathport.com` Email-to-Vault auto-staging, 50 GB vault, unlimited tailored MyPortfolio links, and full MyPath Career Intelligence (Roadmaps, What-If Role Audits, Application & Interview Studio).
- **Reverse Trial & Founding Cohort**: Standard accounts receive a 14-day Pro trial with no credit card required; November 2026 Founding Cohort members receive a 30-day Pro trial. Expired trials never lock or delete uploaded user records.
- **PathPort Workplace (Launching 2027)** & **PathPort Certify (Launching 2027)**: Organization and certifying board pilot cohorts open for 2027 deployment.
